ports.note: A source widget. The file and its declared UTM zone/hemisphere are configuration; the output is the ordinary CRS84 points contract.

ontology.note: A coordinate-transformation activity class and its runtime SHACL shape are not yet defined. Provenance is currently carried as source information on the point layer, not as typed RDF.

changes.description: Import-time projection change from WGS84 UTM metres to CRS84 degrees; see docs/experiments/40-reprojection-primitives.md. WGS84 zones only, no datum shift, no raster warping. Narrower than the general Reproject node proposed in experiment 05.

evidence.note: Unit checks assert UTM definitional invariants (false easting and northing, symmetry about the central meridian), round-trip error within 0.01 m and guard refusals. Independently compared against pyproj 3.8.0 / PROJ 9.8.1 over nine points in zone 35 south: maximum separation 6.70e-05 m against a 1 mm tolerance, explained by the nine-decimal coordinate rounding (see docs/experiments/41-validation-lab.md). That comparison ran in CPython, not a browser kernel, covers one zone, and establishes no datum other than WGS84.
